```sql
WITH fx AS (
    SELECT rate_date, aud_nzd_rate
    FROM staging.stg_erp__fx_rates
),
mats AS (
    SELECT sku, standard_cant_cost_nzd AS standard_cost_nzd -- wait, standard_cost_nzd
    FROM staging.stg_erp__materials
),
-- Let's inspect materials columns: material_id varchar, sku varchar, description varchar, material_group varchar, product_category varchar, standard_cost_nzd decimal(12,2)
items AS (
    SELECT sku, product_category, standard_cost_nzd
    FROM staging.stg_erp__materials
    WHERE product_category = 'Food Storage'
),
-- We need revenue and standard cost of goods for Food Storage in Jan 2026 across POS, Ecom, and ERP
-- POS transaction lines
pos_lines AS (
    SELECT
        t.sku,
        t.quantity,
        t.line_total,
        s.country,
        t.txn_date,
        t.currency
    FROM staging.stg_pos__transaction_lines t
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__stores s ON t.store_id = s.store_id
    WHERE t.txn_date >= '2026-01-01' AND t.txn_date <= '2026-01-31'
      AND t.is_valid = true
),
pos_conv AS (
    SELECT
        p.sku,
        p.quantity AS units,
        CASE WHEN p.currency = 'AUD' THEN p.line_total * f.aud_nzd_rate ELSE p.line_total END AS revenue
    FROM pos_lines p
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON p.txn_date = f.rate_date AND p.currency = 'AUD'
    JOIN items i ON p.sku = i.sku
),
-- Ecom order lines (completed orders, excluding cancelled)
ecom_lines AS (
    SELECT
        l.sku,
        l.quantity,
        l.line_total,
        o.order_date,
        o.currency
    FROM staging.stg_ecom__order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_ecom__orders o ON l.order_id = o.order_id
    WHERE o.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND o.order_date <= '2026-01-31'
      AND o.order_status <> 'cancelled'
),
ecom_conv AS (
    SELECT
        e.sku,
        e.quantity AS units,
        CASE WHEN e.currency = 'AUD' THEN e.line_total * f.aud_nzd_rate ELSE e.line_total END AS revenue
    FROM ecom_lines e
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON e.order_date = f.rate_date AND e.currency = 'AUD'
    JOIN items i ON e.sku = i.sku
),
-- ERP Sales Orders (wholesale)
erp_lines AS (
    SELECT
        m.sku,
        l.quantity,
        l.net_value AS line_total,
        l.order_date,
        l.currency
    FROM staging.stg_erp__sales_order_lines l
    JOIN staging.stg_erp__materials m ON l.material_id = m.material_id
    WHERE l.order_date >= '2026-01-01' AND l.order_date <= '2026-01-31'
),
erp_conv AS (
    SELECT
        e.sku,
        e.quantity AS units,
        CASE WHEN e.currency = 'AUD' THEN e.line_total * f.aud_nzd_rate ELSE e.line_total END AS revenue
    FROM erp_lines e
    LEFT JOIN fx f ON e.order_date = f.rate_date AND e.currency = 'AUD'
    JOIN items i ON e.sku = i.sku
),
all_sales AS (
    SELECT sku, units, revenue FROM pos_conv
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sku, units, revenue FROM ecom_conv
    UNION ALL
    SELECT sku, units, revenue FROM erp_conv
),
agg AS (
    SELECT
        SUM(a.revenue) AS rev,
        SUM(a.units * m.standard_cost_nzd) AS total_cost
    FROM all_sales a
    JOIN items m ON a.sku = m.sku
    WHERE m.standard_cost_nzd IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT 
    CAST((rev - total_cost) / rev AS DOUBLE) AS answer
FROM agg
```
